name: Spoiled by the Sterile Billionaire
overview: After her mother’s death, Sophia Miller undergoes artificial insemination, unaware the sperm belongs to Ethan Carter, a powerful heir who lost his fertility in an accident. Ethan needs an heir to save his empire from his ruthless half-brother. When he discovers Sophia is carrying his child, their lives collide. What begins with suspicion and a forced arrangement soon becomes protection, desire, and love. As family secrets and Sophia’s hidden identity emerge, she fights to reclaim her life while Ethan struggles to earn her trust.
